historical_counts.evidence: Previous Animals article, section 2.1.1 and Table 1; aggregate counts only. Not reconstructed from raw ROS bags.

pair_rule: Exact f_<integer>_rgb.<image-extension> and f_<same integer>_depth.npy within the same BCS/episode directory; ambiguous keys are never silently overwritten.
animal_group_rule: First numeric Cow identifier inherited from the previous study, e.g. Cow_5_1 -> Cow_5. Grouping identifier, not independently verified RFID identity.
label_rule: Integer BCS 2-6 inherited from the parent directory. Class index = BCS-2. Original scale 1-9, with only 2-6 represented here; no new expert rescoring.
quality_policy: Audit all files. No posture, angle, score, or prediction-confidence filtering. Record corruption, missing modalities, invalid depth and exact duplicates separately. Stop before training if unresolved structural errors or cross-group duplicates exist.
split_policy: Reuse and independently reconcile legacy animal-wise outer three-fold membership for matched comparisons. Inner validation uses only non-test groups, seed fixed in advance. No frame-wise split.

preprocessing.rgb_model_input: float32 / 255; any later normalisation must be logged
preprocessing.depth_scale: Per-frame valid-pixel 1st/99th percentiles; clip and scale to [0,1]; invalid pixels zero. Constant-valid maps flagged and set to zero.
preprocessing.depth_resize: nearest neighbour, retaining the invalid mask
preprocessing.depth_units: Unverified in prepared NPY files; no conversion to physical distance claimed.
preprocessing.augmentation: Not applied to the persistent cache. Any training-only augmentation logged by seed/config; augmented views do not increase independent sample counts.
preprocessing.test_frame_selection: Deterministic equally spaced RGB frame indices within each eligible episode; no use of depth, geometry or prediction confidence. Log padding repetitions separately.
